subject: GCP vendor registration + procurement playbook (kickoff & milestones)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@helio.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP vendor registration + procurement playbook (kickoff & milestones)

Team —

I want to kick off a short, pragmatic project to get HelioAI listed on GCP Marketplace and establish a procurement handoff that our Sales + Finance teams can repeat for other co-sell partners. Goals:

- Complete vendor registration and listing artifact bundle within 3 weeks.
- Define the procurement path (PO/contract/DocuSign) and the internal handoffs (Sales -> Deals Ops -> Finance).
- Produce a 1-page playbook + checklist for final handoff to CS.

I attached a first-pass vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx and a simple procurement flow diagram (marketplace_procurement_flow.drawio). Please review and call out missing steps.

Immediate asks:
1) Kimberly — can you confirm the SLA / legal gating items we need before listing (privacy, KMS, SOC2 evidence)?
2) Karthik — outline the typical procurement triggers and the DocuSign path for paid listings; also flag any internal budget approvals we must surface.
3) Marissa — will be the lead for marketplace ops validation; can you estimate validation window (sandbox → public listing)?

If this looks right I'll schedule a 30m sync with Helio and cc GCP partner ops for their intake checklist.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP vendor registration + procurement playbook (kickoff & milestones)

Jordan —

This is great. A couple quick notes after skim:

- SOC2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf) is the only attestation we should share externally at the vendor stage. Full AOC only for procurement/legal.
- Privacy: need a data flow diagram for any customer-managed keys; ask Helio whether they'll require Redwood to use a customer KMS or our managed keys for billing metadata.
- Legal gating: AML/KYC checks are standard for marketplace billing; Deals Ops already has a short form questionnaire we can attach.

Recommended timeline (short):
Week 0: Intake + Partner Ops checklist
Week 1: Vendor registration + SOC2 evidence exchange
Week 2: Procurement paperwork (PO / DS) + public listing prep
Week 3: Validation + go-live

I can take the intake checklist and merge it into your spreadsheet. Quick Q: do we need to pre-seed a price SKU or will Helio run a private preview SKU?

-Kim
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@helio.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: mp-partner@google.com, emily.ross@acme.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 13:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP vendor registration + procurement playbook (kickoff & milestones)

Thanks Jordan, Kim —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few items from Helio's side:

- We prefer a private preview SKU for the first 30 days while we validate billing telemetry. Public pricing comes after.
- We'll need Redwood's SOC2 summary and the vendor_onboarding_checklist filled to our finance team. Can you confirm the preferred channel for DocuSign?
- One blocker: Helio's procurement requires a Vendor W-9 and a short security questionnaire; can Redwood provide a contact for security artifacts (AOC, penetration test cadence)?

Cc'ing GCP Partner Ops to confirm any Marketplace-specific fields they require on the registration form.

- Amit
Product Partnerships, HelioAI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@helio.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP vendor registration + procurement playbook (kickoff & milestones)

Amit —

Short answers and next steps:

- DocuSign: we use the company DocuSign account at https://www.docusign.com/rdw/gcp-psa-sign (I'll initiate templates).
- Procurement triggers: internal quota > $50k requires Finance approval; anything below can be PO via Deals Ops (2–3 business days).
- For marketplace listing we typically create a private-preview SKU and then migrate to public pricing once telemetry is stable — aligns with your ask.

Action items I'm taking:
1) Create DocuSign template for Helio PSA + vendor W-9 (ETA: 1 business day).
2) Add the procurement approval path to vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx and surface the Finance approver.
3) Create a minimal HubSpot deal record for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Quote from internal deal ops playbook: "For Marketplace co-sell, always surface security evidence (SOC2 summary + contact) before public listing."

-Karthik
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, Amit Shah <amit.shah@helio.ai>
Cc: mp-partner@google.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP vendor registration + procurement playbook (kickoff & milestones)

Quick recap and next steps (action owners):

- Kimberly: merge intake checklist into vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx and add legal gating notes (ETA: EOD Tue).
- Karthik: create DocuSign templates + HubSpot deal (ETA: EOD Tue).
- Marissa: schedule validation window and sandbox listing slot with Partner Ops (ETA: Wed morning).
- Amit (Helio): please complete the vendor questionnaire and attach W-9; we'll send a DocuSign envelope once templates are ready.

I'll set a 30m sync for Wed 08/11 10:00 PT with GCP Partner Ops to walk through the registration form and expected fields. Calendar invite to follow.

Thanks everyone — let me know if anything above is blocking.

Jordan
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
